thought: Dusk on Throop Ave, sky deep blue with pink clouds, lamps coming on. A white SUV is parked about five metres to my left. I'll turn to it and walk up to the door.
I'm in the SUV. The radio shows BK House with no sets, and the console is complaining about a blocked fetch. I'll pull out and roll up the avenue.
Doing about 24 km/h with a car five metres ahead. I'll hold the throttle and see whether the traffic moves. If it doesn't I'll go round it.

The street opens up ahead with lit brick walls and a lamp line up the avenue, but the car in front is still crawling, and a wanted star has just lit on the HUD. I'll give a small swing left to get past it and open up.
I'm clear and doing 45 km/h. The avenue ahead has a row of lit shopfronts, a deli sign on the right, and a yellow beam of light marking a Block Party. I'll keep the foot down straight up the avenue.

I've drifted onto the pavement outside a pharmacy, and a Block Party mission has just started on its own from the beam I drove through. The goal is to borrow a speaker from Garvey Cutz, with a two-minute timer. I'll back off the kerb and find the road.

I'm still up on the pavement with a sign pole in front of me and a crosswalk ahead, and the mission timer is ticking down at two minutes. I'll reverse straight back and then swing right onto the road.
Still boxed in by poles, bins and a hydrant, and I've stopped dead. The star has gone, but the car won't turn. I'll reverse straight back with no steering to get clear of the posts.
I've backed clear of the posts and I'm in the open road at 18 km/h. The mission clock is at 1:55. I'll go forward and head up the avenue toward the Pulaski crossing.
The car is pinned again, nose-first into a pole with the same cluster of posts, so forward is blocked. I'll get out and go on foot, following the mission marker.

I'm on foot on the pavement, the SUV pressed against me on the left. A pedestrian in a red top is standing right in front of me, and the mission timer reads 1:50. The minimap marker is up toward the north, so I'll walk that way.
I'm walking north up the pavement now. The timer is down to 1:46 and I still need to find Garvey Cutz. I'll keep going north.

Nice pocket of night here: a lit shopfront with an OPEN sign, lit windows across the street, and a figure in a red BK jacket in front of me on the pavement. The minimap has a blue dot close by, so Garvey Cutz may be near. I'll walk on past him.

I'm still searching for Garvey Cutz, and the mission timer is at 1:39. It's getting properly dark now. I'll check the radio, since the HUD has been saying there are no sets, and try the R key to change station.
